  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The gate explicitly has no provider-outage precheck (`scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh`, lines 599-604). The resume dispatch in `scripts/provider_outage.py` passes only `pr_number` and `allow_workflow_edits` (line 401), so the gate cannot tell it apart. After a successful dispatch, the recovery path removes the review-blocked label (lines 776-793) even when the gate skips the run because of an existing clean marker, so a provider-outage recovery dispatch can be skipped and its recovery label consumed. Source severity is MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this gap as a documented deviation: `force_rb_judge` bypasses the skip at lines 591-592, and the judge cannot be reached on a clean-marker head through a plain dispatch.
